ON THE FINITENESS OF P-ADIC CONTINUED FRACTIONS
FOR NUMBER FIELDS
LAURA CAPUANO, NADIR MURRU, AND LEA TERRACINI
Abstract. For a prime ideal P of the ring of integers of a number field K, we
give a general definition of P-adic continued fraction, which also includes classical
definitions of continued fractions in the field of p–adic numbers. We give some
necessary and sufficient conditions on K ensuring that for all but finitely many
P, every α ∈K admits a finite P-adic continued fraction expansion, addressing a
similar problem posed by Rosen in the archimedean setting.
